# BUSINESS CONTEXT

In Mass Email Communication and Mass SMS Communication, users can import recipients via file using import type *Contracts* (contract number + optional version).

Each Product Contract and Service Contract stores two communication data selections on the contract:

* Communication data for billing
* Communication data for contract

When creating/sending Mass Email or Mass SMS, the user selects one or more *Contact purposes*. The two purposes relevant here are:

* Фактуриране и плащане (Billing and payment)
* Комуникация по договор (Contract communication)

{color:#ff5630}*Current behavior (AS-IS):*{color} After contract import, the system resolves the customer and contract, but when determining email addresses / mobile numbers it looks up communication data on the *customer* filtered by the selected Contact purpose(s). It does not use the communication data explicitly selected on the imported contract.

{color:#36b37e}*Requested Change (TO BE):*{color}

When recipients are added to Mass Email Communication or Mass SMS Communication via *Contract import*, the system must resolve contact details from the *contract’s selected communication data*, based on the Contact purpose(s) chosen on the mass communication:

Contact purpose: Фактуриране и плащане
→ Use *Communication data for billing* selected on the imported contract (Product Contract or Service Contract version).

Contact purpose: Комуникация по договор
→ Use *Communication data for contract* selected on the imported contract (Product Contract or Service Contract version).

The email/mobile contacts used for sending must come from that contract-linked communication data record (and its contact types), not from a generic customer-level lookup by purpose.

# BUSINESS CONTEXT

In Mass Email Communication and Mass SMS Communication, users can import recipients via file using import type *Contracts* (contract number + optional version).

Each Product Contract and Service Contract stores two communication data selections on the contract:

* Communication data for billing
* Communication data for contract

When creating/sending Mass Email or Mass SMS, the user selects one or more *Contact purposes*. The two purposes relevant here are:

* Фактуриране и плащане (Billing and payment)
* Комуникация по договор (Contract communication)

{color:#ff5630}*Current behavior (AS-IS):*{color} After contract import, the system resolves the customer and contract, but when determining email addresses / mobile numbers it looks up communication data on the *customer* filtered by the selected Contact purpose(s). It does not use the communication data explicitly selected on the imported contract.

{color:#36b37e}*Requested Change (TO BE):*{color}

When recipients are added to Mass Email Communication or Mass SMS Communication via *Contract import*, the system must resolve contact details from the *contract’s selected communication data*, based on the Contact purpose(s) chosen on the mass communication:

# Contact purpose: Фактуриране и плащане
→ Use *Communication data for billing* selected on the imported contract (Product Contract or Service Contract version).
# Contact purpose: Комуникация по договор
→ Use *Communication data for contract* selected on the imported contract (Product Contract or Service Contract version).

The email/mobile contacts used for sending must come from that contract-linked communication data record (and its contact types), not from a generic customer-level lookup by purpose.

* If both purposes are selected on the mass communication, the system must use the corresponding contract communication data for each purpose (billing data for billing purpose, contract data for contract purpose).
* If the contract does not have the required communication data for the selected purpose, or the communication data has no valid email (Mass Email) / mobile number (Mass SMS) for sending, the row must be rejected or reported with a clear error for that contract.
